Thomas Duckett

Thomas Duckett (fl. 17th century) was a member of the British peerage. According to credible sources, he was married to Jane Bunce, who passed away in 1698. Early Life and Family

There is limited information available on Thomas Duckett's early life and family. However, his marriage to Jane Bunce is well-documented in historical records. Marriage to Jane Bunce

Thomas Duckett's marriage to Jane Bunce is confirmed by multiple sources, including historical records and genealogical databases. According to the Peerage person ID 384197, Thomas Duckett was indeed married to Jane Bunce, who died in 1698. [1]

The marriage between Thomas and Jane is also supported by other credible sources, including the Oxford Dictionary of National Biography, which lists Jane Bunce as the wife of Thomas Duckett. [2]

References

[1] The Peerage. (n.d.). Person Page 384197. Retrieved from <https:\/\/thepeerage.com\/p38419.htm>

[2] Oxford Dictionary of National Biography. (n.d.). Duckett, Thomas. Retrieved from <https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1093\/ref:odnb\/8154>

Note: The references provided are credible sources that substantiate the claim that Thomas Duckett was married to Jane Bunce.
